title: RESOLVED on main by PR #241: the executive summary had rendered two id="no-line-research" elements, failing a foreign-owned regression test
detail: Observed 2026-10-24T06:20Z while this branch was based at 2f966a9: a clean build wrote site/index.html with two <div class="line-sources" id="no-line-research"> elements because summary() appended the compact unresolved register (which itself called no_line_research_block) and then called the block again, so tests/test_ca7e10e5_snapshot.py asserted 2 != 1. A worktree build at base commit 2f966a9 reproduced the identical failure (plus the three wall-clock date-bomb ERRORs), proving it pre-existed this session's work; neither the test nor the no-line block was edited here. While this branch was in review, main merged PR #240 (bdb4fc9, pinning the date-bomb clock) and PR #241 (e360f4c, rendering the block once on the summary). After rebasing onto 4a6c112 a fresh build writes exactly one id="no-line-research" in site/index.html and one in site/unresolved/index.html, and tests.test_ca7e10e5_snapshot runs 15/15 OK. Kept as a historical verification record; no further action required from this session.

title: Ground Zero vs Off Chops (1082858) has a real Smarkets order book but it fails the 0.15 spread gate, so it correctly stays without a pick
detail: Observed 2026-10-24T06:15Z: Smarkets event 45396333, market 172960355 (WINNER_2_WAY, open) quotes Ground Zero bid 15.62% / offer 31.75% (16.1pp spread) and Off Chops bid 68.03% / offer 84.75% (16.7pp spread). Both exceed MAX_ACCEPTED_SPREAD = 0.15 in scripts/originate.py:60, so the ladder rejects the book and no midpoint is used; prior sessions measured 18.5pp on 2026-10-23 (80c3b4e0) and ~0.185 (43110640), so the book is tightening slowly but still gated. HOTU vs The Huns (1082792) has no Smarkets event at all (no Moscow Cyber Games listing in the 100-event upcoming catalogue). Full evidence and the source-reachability matrix are in data/research/ee124e8b/. Cross-reference, not duplication: after this observation, main merged the automated EGamersWorld rung (scripts/egw_live.py, PR #240) and session 43110640's guided picks (data/research/43110640/unresolved-guided-picks.md) - a Vave 3.44/1.24 aggregated line no-vig 26.5/73.5 for 1082858, and a Valve-standings model direction for 1082792 whose EGW board was only the rejected 1.8/1.8 placeholder. Those are separate, labelled treatments; this flag remains the first-party Smarkets evidence trail. The automated rungs re-price both fixtures on later refreshes without code changes if qualifying books appear before lock.
